slides.headline: The biggest IPO in history just made Anthropic worth $1.5 trillion
slides.subline: **Shares jumped 34% on day one.** Anthropic is the first frontier AI lab you can buy on the stock market.

slides.body: On Thursday, Anthropic began trading on the Nasdaq under the ticker **ANT**. Shares were sold at **$83** and opened at **$111.50**, about [[34% higher]]. The company raised roughly **$81 billion**.

It is the **largest IPO in US history**, bigger than SpaceX's listing in June. Counting every share, the company is valued near [[$2 trillion]]. By midday the stock had cooled to roughly **$99 to $105**.
Stocks were falling that day, and the Dow was down about **1.8%** at midday. Even so, investors lined up for a piece of AI. Would you buy shares in an AI company right now? Tell us below.
